# Ghost r2modman 1.0.6

Based on the public 1.0.5 source archive, with an independent GhostSmelterControl catalog. The original suite channel remains unchanged. A new numeric-version smelter channel uses `smelter-release.json`, `smelter-releases.json`, and immutable `smelter-VERSION/Ghost-GhostSmelterControl-VERSION.zip` assets in the existing owned repository.

The second package joins the actual Dexie/native package list, Update All comparisons, exact profile exports/imports, pruning protection, trusted URL/SHA256/size guard and profile backup. The Ghost rail can apply pending updates for either or both installed Ghost packages. Refresh remains 30 seconds, startup/profile open and focus/visibility. No silent installation into a running game was added.

Build with Node 24 and the bundled pnpm lockfile:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm exec quasar prepare
pnpm typecheck
GHOST_PACK_FIXTURE=/absolute/path/to/extracted/GhostSmelterControl/package pnpm exec vitest run --config ghost.vitest.config.ts
SKIP_PACKING=true pnpm exec quasar build --mode electron -T win32
node scripts/check-ghost-release.cjs . dist/electron/Packaged/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar
```

Verified: typecheck, 54 Ghost checks, Windows directory build, seven actual archive consistency checks, and all 7,868 app.asar regular entries readable with expected sizes. The real install-rule test installs/upgrades the supplied second-mod package and verifies unrelated config/plugins and a main-suite sentinel remain unchanged.

Native Windows GUI, user installation, two live friend endpoints and actual public publishing were not run by these local checks. Keep these states separate. Preserve the original LICENSE, GHOST_R2_NOTICE and Chromium/Electron licenses. Do not package intermediate build files; publish only the completed Windows application directory.
